alex: FYI noticed weird meter behavior when stream + toolcall interleave — console shows 0 provisional tokens for short retries. Repro below.
maria: ugh, can you paste the session id + minimal steps?
alex: session s=us-west-1:abc123; steps: 1) open streaming chat with model=v1; 2) mid-stream toolcall to /rerank returns 204 body empty; 3) client retries stream chunk -> final. Observed: client shows 2 toolcall events but console provisional tokens only counts one. logs:
```
2026-03-20T12:01:22Z INFO request id=abc123 event=toolcall start
2026-03-20T12:01:22Z WARN toolcall status=204 body_len=0
2026-03-20T12:01:23Z INFO stream retry chunk seq=45
```
ken: is this the same as earlier prefix ownership race? might be different since body_len=0 toolcall causes TTL drop on provisional ledger.
maria: can we add a per-session provisional_tokens and confirmed_tokens metric? right now console only shows aggregate per-route.
billing-bot: Found ledger entries: provisional(abc123): [toolcall:0.0 tokens, stream:3.2], confirmed: [stream:3.2]. Query: /ledger/trace?session=abc123
alex: repro script (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream -d '{"session":"abc123","model":"v1"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer...'
# then POST /tool/rerank with same session id quickly -> return 204
```
opsbot: Filed infra ticket INF-2123 to add a dashboard tile for "session provisional delta" and an alert when provisional != confirmed for >2s
maria: can we also show toolcall status codes in console timeline? would help.
ken: I'll PR a change to token-attribution service: if toolcall has 2xx but zero-length body, still emit provisional token stub until TTL expires. small change, tests included.
alex: small ask: please include an example session in the ticket so support can reproduce. thx :thumbsup:
maria: added session and test cases to INF-2123. Assign to ken.
ken: on it, will link PR when ready.
alex: thanks.
